bukti: [parafrasa web] The pipeline comprises three key components: kiwifruit and support-post detection, video-based kiwifruit counting, and detection region adaptation.

[parafrasa web] A two-containers verification (TCV) method was applied following fruit tracking to reduce over-estimation; counting accuracy rose from 40.12% to 94.20% on ByteTrack and 37.59% to 96.65% on DeepSORT.
[parafrasa web] Sequences are captured by smartphones on a stabilizer and extension pole, spanning the full length of each kiwifruit row; results were close to manual counts.
